description: Unit test class for the FieldTypeValidator in the OpenMRS project, testing validation logic for FieldType objects.

classes.name: FieldTypeValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for validating the logic in FieldTypeValidator.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the name of FieldType is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when required fields are properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfFieldTypeNameIsDuplicate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the FieldType name is a duplicate.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
